name: thinking-loader
title: Thinking Loader
description: A calm waiting indicator in three shapes (dots, bar, grid) that share one tempo and never fake progress.

props.name: label
props.description: Text shown before the indicator, also announced to screen readers.

props.name: showElapsed
props.description: Adds a live elapsed-seconds counter. Hidden under reduced motion.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds one cycle takes. All variants share it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
